ghi_chu: SUA LOI SET AGI CO'I MAT NGOC PHUC THAN. Ngoc deo o o Dac thu nen no lot vao bai toan Set AGI nhu moi mon trang bi. Nhung ngoc cho 0 AGI va 0 sat thuong (no cho +2,5 EXP — thu bai toan khong biet), nen phuong an 'de trong o do' hoa diem va THANG, the la bot coi ngoc ra. Do that tren zDia_Chanz luc 11:27. Nay Set AGI khong dung toi ngoc nua, va them luoi: bot khong bao gio TU coi ngoc Phuc Than du duong nao goi. Van coi duoc 5 o thuong de ha AGI nhu cu.
